Subject: Stelaris: Post-demo recap & next steps — commitments, timeline and approval lane

Hi Elena & Raj,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — appreciated the candid overview of the model drift issues you're seeing and the latency/cost constraints when serving agent workflows in production. Quick recap (so we're all aligned) and proposed next steps: 

Summary of pains we heard
- High tail-latency spikes on customer-facing assistants during peak hours (~2–3x baseline).
- Serving costs rising quickly due to lack of batching and inefficient model routing for shorter/structured prompts.
- Auditability & retention: security team needs token-level logs + proof of on-prem key separation for regulated workflows.

Goals you described
- Reduce 95th percentile latency to <450ms for short-turn completions (under 256 tokens).
- Lower per-conversation inference cost by ~30% within pilot window.
- Get security/compliance checklist validated for evaluation and procurement.

Proposed mutual action lane (high level) — first pass
1) Pilot scope & baseline (owner: Stelaris Eng) — Nov 1: identify 2 high-traffic flows to instrument.
2) Redwood pilot setup (owner: Redwood Eng) — Nov 8: provision dedicated pool + suggested batching & KV cache config.
3) Performance run & tuning (joint) — Nov 15–Nov 29: iterate on quantization/profile changes.
4) Security sign-off & procurement (owner: Stelaris Security/Procurement) — target Dec 6: SOC2 artifacts + KMS integration doc.
5) Exec review & commitment (stakeholder: Stelaris CTO) — Dec 13: decision to expand to reserved capacity.

I've attached a short MPA draft (stelaris_mpa_v1.docx) and a preliminary perf/cost estimate (redwood-performance-estimate.pdf). Please consider these a living draft — we can iterate.

Ask: Can you confirm the internal owners for each milestone above (particularly the security/procurement owner) and whether the Dec 13 exec review window works? If you prefer, we can lock a joint 30-minute sync to finalize owners/providers next week.

Thanks,

David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Security/compliance: Priya Sinha (CISO) — she will need the SOC2 artifacts and KMS/HSM details. I will loop her in separately (she's currently out of office until Oct 25).
- Procurement: procurement@stelaris.com — they handle contract & SOW negotiations.

2) Timeline adjustments: Dec 13 for exec review is OK but would prefer if we can get procurement to commit to a draft term sheet by Nov 29 so legal has time to review. If procurement can't meet that date we may need to move exec review + decision to Dec 20.

3) Missing item: can you include a short data residency note for EU traffic (we saw a small percentage routed through EU and need to ensure routing policy options are visible in the MPA).

I'll do a short internal note to Priya and procurement once I confirm the baseline flows with Raj. Happy to meet next Wed (Oct 27) 10:00am PT to finalize owners if that works for the Redwood team.

Elena
